description: Stack knowledge slots. Core agents and skills refer to them as {{slot:<name>}}; every pack provides each slot, marks it not_applicable, or (preview packs only) gets a generated BLOCKED placeholder.

slots.architecture-design: Codebase scan, architectural options and the stack's design.md template for Gate 2.
slots.clean-architecture: Module structure, layer boundaries, contracts and dependency wiring for the stack.
slots.unit-testing: Developer unit tests for the stack: tools, paths and required pass/fail cases.
slots.code-review: The stack's review rubric, validators and blocking rules.
slots.verification: The stack's analyzer, test, build and evidence commands for a reviewed revision.
slots.visual-quality: Launching UI targets and capturing revision-bound visual evidence.
slots.ui-kit-mapping: Where the Client's look comes from (UI kit, Client theme or framework defaults) and how Planning maps extracted Figma tokens.json and <node>.spec.json to existing widgets, Clean Architecture, and C-NN / Core gap records at Gate 2.
slots.clean-code: The stack's language idioms: naming, private and export conventions, debug calls and simplification smells with standard-library replacements.
slots.secure-coding-standards: The stack's security risks: unsafe patterns next to their safe counterparts, secret and token storage, and audit commands.
slots.code-simplification: The stack's simplification smells next to their standard-library or framework replacements, behavior-safety rules, stop criteria and the one-line simplify report.
slots.root-cause-debugging: Reproducing a known failure in the stack, isolating it with the stack's debuggers, logs and test tools, fixing the cause with a regression test, and when to stop and escalate.
slots.bug-hunt: The stack's recurring defect patterns per review dimension, how a candidate is verified before it is reported, and the finding row graded by work-item-contract handoff-and-status section 9.
